title: Aphrodiseus
summary: Raleigh names Aphrodiseus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Aphrodiseus, out of whom Niger writes of the honie dew of Libanus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VII, §. III, subsection VIII, sig. 223b
